target_customer: Engineering firms and machine builders that design industrial electrical control systems
problem: Designing electrical controls, power distribution and P&ID documents is slow and manual, which limits how fast manufacturers can scale production.
business_model: B2B software, AI design agents for engineering firms (pricing not found)
product_category: Design automation for industrial electrical controls (originally GPU model weight swapping infrastructure)

founders.name: Towaki Takikawa
founders.background_notes: YC page: research scientist at NVIDIA on simulation R&D including neural fields and 3D generative models; earlier robotics systems engineering and CNC machining.

competitors.name: Modal and Baseten (positioned as adjacent platforms)
competitors.what: Developer platforms for hosting model inference

technical_complexity.rationale: The original product cached model weights in pinned RAM for fast swaps, which is systems level work. The current product parses drawings and generates validated CAD and control logic.

defensibility.rationale: Domain specific engineering outputs and integrations with industrial tools are harder to copy than generic LLM wrappers. Evidence of lock in is limited.

incumbents: Inference platforms for the original idea
Industrial CAD vendors for the current one

market_need_then: The Launch HN post in August 2024 claimed simulations projecting about a 40 percent GPU cost cut from faster model swaps. This was a company simulation claim, not customer evidence.

branding.domain_note: Uses outerport.com. Legal entity is Genban, Inc. per its site.

identity.logo: White logo variant shown on site
identity.visual_style: Engineering drawing style with single line diagrams, P&IDs and numbered sections

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive technical voice, but the port metaphor fits the first product and little brand coverage was found.

pivots.from: Instant hot swapping of AI model weights on GPUs (Launch HN, 2024-08-23)
pivots.to: AI design automation for industrial electrical controls

outcome_analysis: Outerport is active with a small team. It launched in August 2024 selling model weight hot swapping and has since turned to design automation for industrial electrical controls, with a named Daikin case study and investors including Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund. Round sizes are not public in the sources found.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators show 500K pre-seed on 2024-09-25 (the YC deal), a 125K Dealroom seed, a 10M figure on a YC investor list and 65M on Sacra for what looks like another product; none confirmed so no round recorded. Competitor entry comes from a 2025 Sacra summary, not a source dated at founding; weak. The original idea is described through a Launch HN mirror. Founder education not found.
